commands.name: custom-store
commands.title: Custom Store
commands.subtitle: Extensions from your own sources

preferences.name: repository
preferences.title: Repository
preferences.description: A source of built extension bundles: a directory, or an http(s) URL serving index.json. More sources are added inside the store; this one is always read first. A leading ~ expands to your home directory.
